Index: /root/repos/pre-commit/tests/git_test.py
===================================================================
--- /root/repos/pre-commit/tests/git_test.py
+++ /root/repos/pre-commit/tests/git_test.py
@@ -140,8 +140,21 @@
     ret = set(git.get_conflicted_files())
     assert ret == {'conflict_file'}
 
 
+def test_get_conflicted_files_refname_collision(in_merge_conflict):
+    """A tracked file named like a refname must not break the diff."""
+    resolve_conflict()
+
+    for filename in ('HEAD', 'MERGE_HEAD'):
+        with open(filename, 'w') as refname_file:
+            refname_file.write('contents\n')
+    cmd_output('git', 'add', 'HEAD', 'MERGE_HEAD')
+
+    ret = set(git.get_conflicted_files())
+    assert ret == {'conflict_file', 'HEAD', 'MERGE_HEAD'}
+
+
 MERGE_MSG = b"Merge branch 'foo' into bar\n\nConflicts:\n\tconflict_file\n"
 OTHER_MERGE_MSG = MERGE_MSG + b'\tother_conflict_file\n'
